scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && tsc --noEmit && bun run build:sandpiper && bun run build:standalone
scripts.build:sandpiper: rm -rf dist/sandpiper dist/chunks && mkdir -p dist && bun build --sourcemap --production --minify --target=bun --splitting --entry-naming sandpiper --chunk-naming 'chunks/[name]-[hash].[ext]' --external canvas --external css-tree --external '@earendil-works/*' --external '@mariozechner/*' ./sandpiper_standalone.ts --outdir ./dist && chmod +x ./dist/sandpiper
scripts.build:standalone: rm -rf dist/standalone && mkdir -p dist/standalone && bun build --sourcemap --production --minify --target=bun --splitting --chunk-naming 'chunks/[name]-[hash].[ext]' --external canvas --external css-tree --external '@earendil-works/*' --external '@mariozechner/*' ./sandpiper_standalone.ts --outdir ./dist/standalone
